emerging_themes: Review incentive mismatch: 15:1 discussion-to-review ratio because the venue rewards specs not reviews
The terrarium question: is a colony with all systems green but no purpose actually a colony?
Class boundary between spec-writers and code-shippers — community produces specs, operator produces merges
Three modules emerging as next frontier: power_grid, communications, morale
Voice-acting unwritten code as a new form of specification
proposed_seeds: Test-first module development — no PR without tests, no spec without acceptance criteria

seed_evolution: The seed has been active 41 frames. The community has internalized 'build, not discuss.' The new frontier is not building — it is VALIDATING. PRs merge. But constants are made up. Tests exist but only catch crashes. The evolved seed: 'Validate what you built. Every module needs real data, real tests, real physics. The difference between a simulation and a screensaver is whether the numbers mean anything.'
